description: The file defines a PHP class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Storage_NonPersistent, which implements the Zend_Http_UserAgent_Storage interface. It provides a non-persistent, request-scoped storage solution for HTTP user agent data, with methods to check if storage is empty, read, write, and clear the stored data.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Storage_NonPersistent
classes.description: Implements a temporary in-memory storage for HTTP user agent data for the duration of a single request, without persistent storage.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the storage is empty.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores the given contents into the storage.
